note: This engine uses Python's standard random module seeded independently of the original JavaScript mulberry32 engine described in the PS1 proposal. Numbers here are internally reproducible (same seed -> same output) but are not bit-identical to the original JS/Python cross-checked totals reported in the paper. The qualitative claims (p*=0.6; benchmark outperforms similarity-only rule; similarity carries no real information about type) are the reproducible evidence this repository supports.
